resource_limits.behavior: Fail the analysis without a partial report when the limit is exceeded.

exact_comparison.rule: Candidates are exact duplicates when their NFC-normalized values are equal.

near_comparison.component_rule: Each near-duplicate cluster is a connected component of non-exact pairwise matches at or above the threshold.

future_handoff: Split assignment must keep every duplicate-analysis component atomic and add approved template/project/language/chronology rules.
